tool_args.rationale: Acquire the trajectory batch to identify the four coupled-ODE parameters before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The four-parameter coupled model is not sufficiently identified by the pilot trajectories; the supplied guidance calls for at least eight rows.
The verified history-conditioned mechanism and irregular-prefix guidance specifically identify the trajectory batch as the relevant measurement.
It does not resolve the memory-ODE parameter ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Reduced snapshot ODE or Maxwell decay
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag favor a history-conditioned model.
